pulls.title: Add scone packet observed event
pulls.author: RaghavKej
pulls.body:
Added a packet_observed event for network elements to record SCONE information (received and, where applicable, modified).

Updated the event summary table, IANA registration, abstract, and introduction accordingly.

pulls.title: Packet received fixes
pulls.author: hfstco
pulls.body:
Clarify packet_received timing and discard reasons
Two fixes to scone:packet_received:
- Emit the event only once the coalesced QUIC packets have been processed,
  since that is when the endpoint knows whether the SCONE packet was
  accepted or discarded (SCONE Section 5.3).
- Extend the `reason` enum with `not_negotiated`, `not_first_packet` and a
  catch-all `unspecified`, and move comments ahead of their values as in
  the qlog drafts. `reason` is now SHOULD when discarded, still MUST NOT
  when accepted.

pulls.title: Advice events
pulls.author: hfstco
pulls.body:
Tightens up the two advice events so tools can tell them apart at a
monitoring-period boundary.
- advice_updated now follows the usual qlog `*_updated` shape: `old` /
`new` (bits per second, `old` absent when no advice was in effect) plus
an optional `trigger` ("packet_received" or "period_expired"). The
common-cases list says which trigger applies to each.
- advice_expired is now explicitly only for the case where the period
ends and nothing takes over; if other advice becomes effective the
endpoint logs advice_updated instead, never both (SCONE 5.4). Also adds
`previous_rate_signal` next to `previous_throughput_advice`.

pulls.title: Add privacy considerations for logged advice
pulls.author: hfstco
pulls.body: The Security Considerations section only pointed to Section 14 of the qlog main schema. Logged `rate_signal` / `throughput_advice` values additionally reveal the policy an access network applied to the logging endpoint and can help identify that network or the endpoint’s subscription (cf. Section 10 of the SCONE protocol draft). This adds one paragraph noting this and recommending the data minimization/anonymization guidance of Section 14.3 of the qlog main schema when logs are shared.

pulls.title: Use datagram_payload_checksum instead of datagram_id
pulls.author: hfstco
pulls.body:
**Wait until release of version 14 of draft-ietf-quic-qlog-quic-events.**

The QUIC qlog events draft no longer has a `datagram_id` field. Coalesced packets are now correlated with their UDP datagram via `datagram_payload_checksum` (CRC32c of the UDP payload, Section 9 of [draft-ietf-quic-qlog-quic-events](https://github.com/quicwg/qlog/blob/main/draft-ietf-quic-qlog-quic-events.md)). Since a SCONE packet is always coalesced with QUIC packets, this is what lets tools join `scone:packet_received` with the quic:packet_received events from the same datagram.

Changes:

- rename `datagram_id` → `datagram_payload_checksum` in SCONEPacketSent and SCONEPacketReceived
- point to Section 9 of QLOG-QUIC after both CDDL figures
- add QLOG-QUIC as a normative reference (it was already cited but not listed)
